name: peru-social-contributions
description: Compute ordinary Peruvian employer health contributions and employee pension deductions for 2026, distinguishing EsSalud, ONP and each AFP commission regime. Use for EsSalud minimum bases, EPS credits, AFP insurance ceilings, ONP versus AFP, PLAME Form 0601, T-Registro, payroll bank reconciliation, CTS and gratificaciones. Covers the October minimum-wage change, November SBS snapshot, fifth-category withholding interface, employer versus employee costs, independent pension contributions and documentary exceptions. Produces a source-linked working paper and a reconciliation to filings and payments. Ask for the service period, pension affiliation, remuneration components and supporting records before calculating. Foreign assignments, special labour regimes and missing period-specific insurance rates require a separate documented assessment.
